text:
Alex Chen: Mosaic competitor follow-up: legal requested an interop checklist + POC owners. Need a short plan by EOD. Who takes what?
Maya Singh: I'll run prompt parity and the semantic diff harness. Requesting their sample prompts (10 intents).
Rowan Kim: I'll build a minimal compat shim that accepts their endpoints and proxies to Redwood. Will support both streaming and poll flows and map model names.
Sophie Li: I'll fill the security questionnaire (TLS, KMS, retention, webhook signing). Send me the link and any specific residency asks.
Ben Carter: On pricing: propose $5k trial credit + alerting and a soft throttle at 4 RPS. We can expand if they request Dedicated for the POC.
build-bot: Task created: "deploy compat-shim to staging" assigned to Rowan Kim.
Rowan Kim: Quick curl examples (stream & poll):
```bash
# stream
curl -X POST https://compat.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream'
# poll
curl -X POST https://compat.redwood.test/v1/async -d '{"model":"mosaic-batch"}' -H 'Idempotency-Key: 1234'
```
Maya Singh: I'll run 800 canonical prompts after the shim is up. Acceptance thresholds: top-1 exact match >=80% after normalization OR semantic similarity >=0.9; median latency <200ms for 512-token base; streaming order preserved 99%.
Sophie Li: Security link: https://redwood-internal/poqs/mosaic-2026 - I'll mark residency TODOs for Eng Infra. Default logs retention 30d, BYOK available for Private.
Alex Chen: Action items recap: Rowan deploy shim to staging; Maya run parity harness; Sophie finish questionnaire; Ben finalize trial credit terms with Sales Ops. If parity failures >15% escalate to ML.
Rowan Kim: Pushing image to registry: registry.redwood/staging/compat-mosaic:v0.1. Smoke at 1pm PT tomorrow.
Ben Carter: I'll draft the trial addendum and send to Sales Ops.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Keep updates here. If legal signs the addendum we'll start Wed morning.
note: sales presales Slack thread coordinating a compatibility POC for migrating from a competitor API: owners, shim/example curls, acceptance thresholds, security questionnaire link, and trial credit discussion
